payload.description: The owner chose the v3 receiver text as the default (option A), with v1 kept as an override for models, CLIs and wake paths not measured with v3 (agent-mailbox spec, sections 16 and 17). The mailbox lands with v3 fixed. Design the override key together with the Config lane: its name, its scope, and how doctor reports which text is active.
payload.title: Config key to override the mailbox receiver instruction
payload.verify: a project can select the v1 receiver instruction through config, the default stays v3, and doctor names the active text
